Machine-consumed markers (_mcp_llm.py tool docstrings as MCP wire API surface; _config_schema.py read-via: markers consumed by check_config_reads.py CI gate) cannot be recovered or relocated without breaking CI and API contracts.

ADRs proposed from review_bot/ (bounded shutdown drain/cancel/grace-period chain, deploy-safe in-flight counter with deliberate over-count, retryable coverage-gap deferral) must be created only if they document current live invariants, not as replacements for inline comments.
